oura._setup: Go to https://cloud.ouraring.com/personal-access-tokens, create a token, paste it below.

strava._setup: Go to https://www.strava.com/settings/api, create an API application (Authorization Callback Domain: localhost), paste the Client ID and Client Secret below.

usda._setup: Go to https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup.html, sign up (instant, free, no card), paste the API key below.

anthropic._setup: Go to https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys, create an API key, paste it below.
